notes: DiscoFlate v3.70.0 — audit fixes. Bonus Rounds now actually save (they were silently dropped on every write). Renaming a scene group follows every reference — the intro, the after-group, the pause overlay and every scene_group row — instead of quietly breaking your intro; renaming a command now also follows minigame tiers, prizes, range actions, chat buttons and the Go Live list. Adding a discovered device no longer errors. Any channel can be marked Announce only (receives broadcasts, ignores commands), replacing the single Announce channel. The typed !enter is gone — competitions are button-driven.
